name: 到達章をたどる読書計画
prompt:
Create one portrait Japanese reading-plan timeline matching the layout in reference 2 on a pure white 390 by780 canvas. No phone frame, status bar, navigation, or extra screen content.
Reference 1 is the authoritative original Fable screenshot for milestone anatomy, timeline, icons, visible states, spacing and protected content. Reference 2 is the exact editable Japanese preview for canvas, wording, and anchor coordinates. Reference 3 is a crop/alignment aid. Reference 4 is the exact facilitator bookshelf photo with its pink ring; place it unchanged, without repainting or retouching. Reference 5 shows the owner's preferred neutral palette only; do not copy its one-card layout.
Owner preference: avoid pastel tint colors. Use white card and badge surfaces with subtle neutral gray borders; no mint or pink fill, no green wash, no gradient, no colored shadow. Keep forest green #174C36 only for the first card's narrow 3px top rule and small outlined milestone icons / active marker. Use neutral gray for the timeline and future markers. Keep the portrait's original pink ring because it belongs to the protected photo.
Canvas and exact layout:
- A 1px pale gray vertical timeline at x26 from y18 to y738.
- First white card x54 y8, width320 height202, radius3, 1px #E4E4E4 border; a flat #174C36 top rule x54 y8 width320 height3.
- First badge x68 y22, width106 height22, white fill, thin #D9D9D9 outline, radius3. Add a small clean forest outline rocket at x74 y27, then 到達点 1 in Meiryo Regular 12px. Keep it fully inside the badge.
- 21日間, Meiryo Regular 12px, right aligned at x280 y25 width80.
- 3月3日, Meiryo Bold 14px line height24 at x68 y68 width66; a thin pale gray divider at x136 y64 height34; 読み始めましょう, Meiryo Bold 20px line height28 at x148 y66 width210.
- Place reference 4's exact circular portrait at x68 y120 size34 by34. Add 進行役・ジャクリーン in Meiryo Regular 12px line height16 at x116 y118, then 案内役 in Meiryo Regular 12px line height16 gray #6E6E6E at x116 y142. Add ようこそ！ in Meiryo Regular 14px line height24 at x68 y178.
- Second white card x54 y234 width320 height124, radius3 and subtle neutral border. Its white outlined badge is x68 y246 width106 height22; add a small forest outline open-book icon and 到達点 2. Date 3月12日 in Meiryo Bold 14px at x68 y288. Add ここまで読む in Meiryo Regular 12px gray at x148 y284 and 第25章・見知らぬ人 in Meiryo Bold 20px at x148 y312.
- Third white card x54 y386 width320 height124 with the same neutral styling. Badge 到達点 3, outline book icon; date 3月22日 at x68 y440; ここまで読む at x148 y436; title 第50章・モレル一家 at x148 y464.
- Fourth white card x54 y538 width320 height124 with the same neutral styling. Badge 到達点 4, outline book icon; date 4月1日 at x68 y592; ここまで読む at x148 y588; title 第75章・証言 at x148 y616.
- Small timeline nodes at x19 y32, y258, y410, y562, each 14 by14. The first is the active first milestone: white fill, forest outline and small forest center dot. The other three are white fill with light gray outline. Connect them with the neutral gray line.
- 次の節目へ続きます in Meiryo Regular 12px gray #6E6E6E at x54 y710.
Use near-black #1D1D1D for primary text, #6E6E6E for secondary text, #E4E4E4 for card borders and timeline, white backgrounds, and no other surface colors. Preserve exact Japanese copy and source content. Keep regular and bold text roles distinct. Do not add extra card content, buttons, overlays, gradients, or decorative illustration.
reviewNotes: White cards and badges remove tinted fills; layout differs from the native Japanese preview and exact protected portrait preservation is unverified.
